title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. translated_title: Fed-Universe：面向联邦系统中协商对齐的语义-几何-拓扑-人本（S-G-T-H）架构栈
translated_abstract: 传统的联邦学习隐式地以全局均值进行优化，形成了“一刀切”的范式，在跨站点异质性下不可避免地压制了少数群体。为弥合这一关键差距，我们提出了Fed-Universe，一种可泛化的语义-几何-拓扑-人本（S-G-T-H）架构，将被动平均转变为去中心化对齐的主动协商。S层部署具备边缘计算能力的大语言模型作为语义代理，将异构输入转化为标准化的患者画像提示。G层通过从统计参数空间到物理可解释质量域的映射 f: Theta -> Q 实施几何质量保证（GQA），并采用余弦相似度门控，基于物理几何而非统计邻近性来保留少数群体更新。T层执行拓扑帕累托控制，识别基于灵敏度的膝点（lambda_k）以平衡多个目标（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Fed-Universe语义-几何-拓扑-人本（S-G-T-H）四层架构，将联邦学习中被动的参数平均转变为主动协商对齐，解决跨站点异质性下少数群体被压制的问题。
en_tdlr: Fed-Universe introduces a Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) stack that transforms passive averaging into active negotiated alignment in federated systems, addressing the suppression of minority sites under cross-site heterogeneity.
